mentions.name: Article-to-speech reader
mentions.description: A web app that converts articles into spoken audio using piper text-to-speech models. Users can send links via one click in the browser or two taps on a phone; the audio is published to an RSS feed that can be subscribed to in podcast apps, and the web app also serves as a reading list and tracker. Ongoing work includes improving the synthesized voice, tuning piper model settings, and better extracting only the real content from a page to record.
mentions.problem: The author wants to read every HN article whose title they find interesting but doesn't have the time to read right at that moment.
mentions.audience: Something used daily by the author to keep up with articles they find interesting but lack time to read at the moment.
mentions.source_excerpt:
it's very basic article to speech using piper models at the moment.

https://reader.n0tls.com/

The part I cared about was being able to send links via one click in my browser or two taps on my phone as I want to read every HN article who's title I find interesting, but don't have the time to read right at that moment.
